notes.title: Game 24
notes.notes:
Hello everybody! 
Until I am re- develop NEVERENDING CHECK-IN: THE HOTEL STORIES and I need more time to show youy my first result - I want to tell you about [b]Game 24[/b].

I started creating the game six months ago with the aim of spreading the story about Ukrainians, about our history and about the Ukrainian/Russian war.
Yes, it is raw, so there is still a lot to do, because I am doing it myself, a friend joined me recently and this is our first experience, we are not developers :)

The demo for my game, "24," is now live and available for you to try on both Windows and Mac!

Despite the challenges, we are passionate about this project and hope it resonates with you. The demo is now available and we would love for you to check it out and share your feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215487/2edd843801a00961253c02776e5a7a8102221fef.png[/img]

Thank you for your support and for helping us bring this story to life!

notes.title: 📔 Date release update 📔
notes.notes:
Dear Neverending Check-in: The Hotel Stories Community,

I hope this message finds you well. I wanted to take a moment to express my gratitude for your unwavering support and enthusiasm for our game, Neverending Check-in: The Hotel Stories. Your feedback, encouragement, and dedication have been invaluable throughout this journey.

I have an important update to share with you all. As some of you may know, I have been collaborating with a friend on this project. However, circumstances have led my friend to pursue other endeavors, and as a result, I have decided to continue developing Neverending Check-in solo.

While this transition may bring its challenges, I want to assure you that I am fully committed to delivering the best possible experience. I am incredibly passionate about this project, and I am determined to see it through to completion.

With this in mind, I have adjusted our release timeline slightly. The new anticipated release date for Neverending Check-in: The Hotel Stories is now set for the second quarter of 2025. This extra time will allow me to ensure that every aspect of the game meets the high standards that you, the community, deserve.

I understand that waiting for something you're excited about can be tough, but I genuinely believe that the final product will be worth it. Your patience and continued support mean the world to me, and I cannot thank you enough for standing by me on this journey.

Please stay tuned for further updates as development progresses. I will make sure to keep you informed every step of the way. Together, we'll make Neverending Check-in: The Hotel Stories everything we've dreamed it to be.

Thank you once again for your incredible support and understanding.

Warm regards,
Oleksii

notes.title: 📔 Dev Diary Entry #1: Unveiling Aeleria 📔
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I've been working tirelessly, and today I'm incredibly excited to share a glimpse of something I've been pouring my heart into: Aeleria, the City in The Sky.

Imagine floating islands, bustling markets, and shimmering streets where every stone feels alive. Aeleria is a marvel, a blend of magic and beauty high above the clouds.

But as with all places, conflicts and stories intertwine. The age-old feud between the fiery House of Lion in striking reds and the strategic House of Hawk in calming greens has been shaping the city's legacy. Their stories, rivalries, and politics are the heartbeat of Aeleria.

Dive into the central island, and you'll find the heartbeat of trade — a vast market shadowed by towering structures. And yes, those majestic harbors you'll see? They welcome airships from lands far and wide, all thanks to a unique magic that keeps them afloat.

I can't wait for you all to immerse yourselves in this world, to feel its pulse and embrace its stories. Here's a little peek of Aeleria's development in Unity. 🎮

notes.title: The Whispering Woods of An
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, adventurers![/b]

We're thrilled to unveil a new realm in our game: [b]The Whispering Woods of An[/b]. This ancient forest, touched by the goddess An, the Elegant Melody, is not just a place, but an experience. Here, the trees tell tales, and the winds carry the songs of ages past. Elven guardians maintain its beauty and secrets, and now, it's waiting for you to explore. Are you ready to venture into its depths and discover the magic within? Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Free Demo Now Available!
notes.notes:
Greetings to our amazing community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215487/f9eefec75a673959700e21e60cc0d6d97f05214d.png[/img]

We have some exciting news for you all. After months of development, testing, and refining, we're delighted to announce the release of our FREE demo version!

This demo offers you a sneak peek into the world we've crafted, showcasing some of the unique features, mechanics, and narratives you can expect in the full game. We believe this will give everyone a taste of the excitement and adventures that await.

Why should you try the demo?

Experience firsthand some of our game's core mechanics.
Engage with a portion of the captivating storyline.
Test out our gameplay and provide invaluable feedback.
Your feedback is instrumental. After playing the demo, please consider dropping your thoughts, suggestions, and any bugs you might encounter in the community forums. Your input will play a significant role in refining the final game.

The journey has just begun, and we're thrilled to have you with us. Dive into the demo, explore, and most importantly, have fun!

Thank you for your unwavering support and passion.

Warm regards,
UAGeeks
